name: CT test terminal
summary: A current-transformer terminal arrangement providing documented test and shorting facilities.
description: A CT test-terminal arrangement connects current-transformer secondary wiring to measurement or protection equipment and provides the test or short-circuit facilities specified for the selected assembly. Its representation must be read with the manufacturer circuit and operating documentation.

Test-disconnect terminals are not all interchangeable. CT applications require the correct shorting behaviour and accessory arrangement. This reference explains what to identify in a drawing, not a procedure for disconnecting or working on a live CT circuit.
readingNotes: Identify each CT secondary path and the associated test or shorting connections.
Do not infer the operation of a test plug or link from a generic terminal mark.
drawingChecklist: Identify shorting links and test accessories.
Cross-reference the CT and connected measurement device.
distinction: A generic disconnect terminal is not automatically suitable for a CT secondary circuit. Use an arrangement specified for the CT application.
